caption:
A spinning blade tears through Paris.
Seedance 2.5 sent one blade across all of Paris.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 4:3 aspect ratio. Hyper-realistic cinematic live-action, like a stylish French action short: shot on a digital cinema camera with wide 24mm and 35mm lenses, shallow depth of field, soft overcast spring daylight, wet reflective streets, pastel color grade dominated by cherry-blossom pink, cream stone and soft teal, fine film grain. Camera feel: one continuous "follow the projectile" chase — the camera rides just behind or beside a spinning throwing blade at high speed, low over the ground, with heavy motion blur and whip-fast cuts at each new obstacle, then slows to a calm locked-off portrait at the end. Pacing: frantic and accelerating for 20 seconds, then a 10-second cool, slow payoff.

SIGNATURE OBJECT (identical in every shot): THE BLADE — a flat, dark gunmetal-steel throwing blade with two long thin leaf-shaped blades pointing in opposite directions from a small round central hub, about 40 cm tip to tip; it spins flat and horizontal like a propeller, with a faint metallic glint and a whirring blur.

CHARACTERS (identical in every shot):
- THE THROWER: seen only from behind — short glossy black hair, black fitted jacket, black leather tactical glove with a wrist strap and cut-out knuckles, a silver ring on the gloved finger.
- THE LITTLE GIRL: about 4, fair skin, rosy cheeks, long straight light-brown hair, big brown eyes. Bright yellow glossy hooded raincoat with black buttons, yellow rain boots. She is blowing up a pink balloon.
- TWO WOMEN: late 20s, both in classic beige belted trench coats; one with long wavy dark-brown hair carrying a tan leather handbag, one with long strawberry-blonde hair.
- BUS PASSENGERS: a young woman with long brown hair in a cream cable-knit sweater; a bearded dark-haired man in a dark coat; a man in a white sweater.
- THE FIRE DANCER: a stocky figure in a bright red hood-balaclava covering the whole head and face, dark brown work clothes, holding a long staff.
- THE TAXI DRIVER: middle-aged man with short dark hair and rectangular glasses, dark jacket.
- THE OLD LADY: about 80, curly white hair, pale sky-blue coat.
- THE FINAL GIRL: East Asian young woman, about 19, pale skin, delicate face, sleepy cool expression. Very long straight platinum-blonde hair with heavy blunt bangs, a small navy ribbon bow clipped on the right side of her head. Black choker, navy sailor school uniform with a white sailor collar trimmed with navy stripes, bright red necktie, black knee socks; an oversized charcoal-grey padded utility jacket with black straps worn off the shoulders. A white earbud in her ear, a large black smartphone in her left hand, a white lollipop stick in her mouth.

LOCATION: Paris in cherry-blossom season on a grey overcast day after rain. A wide boulevard of cream Haussmann stone buildings with wrought-iron balconies and grey zinc roofs, lined on both sides by huge fluffy pink cherry trees, pink petals scattered on the wet dark asphalt, distant pedestrians in dark coats. Later: a square with a zebra crossing, a café with a cream awning and outdoor round marble tables with rattan bistro chairs, and finally a narrow, quiet stone alley paved with wet grey cobblestones.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.5) — The throw. Close over-the-shoulder shot from behind the thrower's head: the black-gloved hand raised beside the head grips the blade by one tip, its other tip pointing down the pink cherry-tree boulevard; the hand snaps forward and releases.

SHOT 2 (00:00.5-00:01.6) — Launch. Camera rockets forward at ground level down the centre of the wet boulevard, pink trees streaking past on both sides, a tiny yellow figure far away in the middle of the road.

SHOT 3 (00:01.6-00:04.1) — The balloon. Low tracking shot just behind and above the spinning blade as it skims the wet asphalt, leaving a ripple in a puddle. MUST SHOW: the blade spinning flat in the foreground, centred. Ahead, the little girl in the yellow raincoat stands in the middle of the road blowing up a pink balloon held to her mouth; with each breath the balloon swells until it hides her whole face and fills the centre of the frame. The blade slices into the balloon.

SHOT 4 (00:04.1-00:05.6) — The pop. Medium close-up of the little girl, frontal, eye level: the pink balloon bursts into flying pink rubber shreds; only a tiny deflated pink scrap is left pinched at her lips. MUST SHOW: the blade spinning horizontally just in front of her nose. Her eyes pop open and slide sideways to follow it, cheeks still puffed.

SHOT 5 (00:05.6-00:07.3) — The two women. Low forward-tracking shot down the boulevard: the two women in beige trench coats walk toward camera side by side; the blade flies straight between them at hip height. The wind of its passing whips their long hair up and back; both gasp with mouths open, frozen mid-step, as the camera rushes between them.

SHOT 6 (00:07.3-00:09.0) — The bus. The boulevard opens onto a square with a white zebra crossing; a white city bus with a teal roof band and colourful poster ads on its side crosses from right to left. Camera races low across the crossing, the pavement streaking with motion blur, straight at the side of the bus until its windows fill the frame.

SHOT 7 (00:09.0-00:11.0) — Shattered glass. Interior side view inside the bus, looking at a side window: the blade punches through the glass, which explodes into a radial spiderweb of cracks and a burst of flying white shards around it. MUST SHOW: the radial crack pattern spreading from the centre of the frame. The woman in the cream sweater (left) flinches and covers her face with both hands; the bearded man (right) jerks back; yellow grab poles in frame.

SHOT 8 (00:11.0-00:11.5) — Through the bus. From inside the bus looking out the opposite window: the blade bursts out through that window in a puff of glass dust, passengers seen from behind in the blue seats.

SHOT 9 (00:11.5-00:12.5) — The square. Camera skims low over a second zebra crossing toward a café-lined square with two pink cherry trees; in the middle of the road stands the fire dancer in the red hood holding a long staff.

SHOT 10 (00:12.5-00:14.2) — Ring of fire. Low frontal tracking push-in: the fire dancer charges toward camera carrying a large blazing ring of fire (about 2 metres across) upright in front of their body on a horizontal staff, roaring orange flames, sparks and glowing reflections on the wet cobbles. MUST SHOW: the burning circle centred in frame with the red-hooded figure framed inside it. The blade flies right through the centre of the ring; the camera follows through it, flames washing across the whole frame.

SHOT 11 (00:14.2-00:15.2) — The taxi. Side tracking shot along the café front: a black boxy taxi cab drives left to right; the blade streaks past just over its hood.

SHOT 12 (00:15.2-00:16.4) — The driver. Close-up through the taxi's open side window: the driver in glasses rears back, mouth wide open in a shout, as the blade whirs past inches from his face, orange indicator lights glowing in the blur.

SHOT 13 (00:16.4-00:17.9) — The café. Wide then close: an outdoor café terrace of round marble tables, white coffee cups and rattan chairs, pink paper fan-flowers in small vases. The old lady in the pale blue coat swivels and reaches out an open hand as the blade spins past her table, slicing past a pink paper flower that spins in its wind.

SHOT 14 (00:17.9-00:19.4) — The alley. Camera bursts through a blur of pink blossoms into a narrow wet cobblestone alley between tall cream stone walls; an old woman in a navy floral dress walks on the left; ahead a cyclist pedals away with a big orange balloon tied behind. The blade closes in until the orange balloon fills the frame, then cuts through it.

SHOT 15 (00:19.4-00:21.0) — The reveal. The orange balloon bursts into flying orange shreds, revealing far down the alley the final girl sitting cross-legged on a rattan bistro chair in the middle of the cobbles, looking down at her phone, an elderly woman in a pink coat walking away behind her. Camera glides toward her.

SHOT 16 (00:21.0-00:25.0) — The catch. Medium shot, frontal, locked-off, eye level, her centred: without looking up from her phone she lazily raises her right index finger, and the blade lands on her fingertip and keeps spinning there, balanced flat. MUST SHOW: the blade spinning horizontally on the tip of one raised finger in front of her face. Her long blonde hair lifts slightly in its wind. She glances at it, bored, lollipop stick in her mouth.

SHOT 17 (00:25.0-00:30.0) — Cool finish. Same frontal medium shot, slow subtle push-in: she closes her hand around the blade and casually clips it into the front of her sailor collar like a brooch, where it stays, pointing down beside her red tie. She takes the round pink lollipop out of her mouth, gives it a lick, pops it back in, and lowers her eyes to her phone. Hold to the end.

SOUND: a tense, pulsing cinematic electronic beat with deep percussion that builds through the chase and drops out to a soft, cool low synth for the final girl. A constant high metallic whirring whoosh follows the blade, with doppler swishes as it passes each person. Sharp rubbery balloon pops (shots 4 and 15), the women's gasps, a huge crystalline glass shatter and tinkling shards (shots 7-8), a deep roaring whoomph of fire, a taxi horn and the driver's startled shout, clinking café cups, bicycle bell, light lollipop click. No spoken lines.
prompt_short: Hyper-real 4:3 Paris in cherry-blossom season: a spinning throwing blade races through the city, popping a girl's balloon, shattering a bus window, flying through a ring of fire, and lands spinning on the fingertip of a cool blonde schoolgirl.
